keyboard.options: In an exam, press 1-6 (or A-F) to choose an option, and 1 or 2 for true/false.

1.title: Welcome to Gradix
1.body: Gradix writes a different, fair question set for every student from your own material, in English, Urdu, Arabic or Persian.

2.title: Create an assessment
2.body: Upload notes, pick resources or add links, choose question types and counts. The learning objectives are found for you.

3.title: Review and publish
3.body: Check the objectives, then publish in the languages your class needs. Students can start once their language is ready.

4.title: Run live sessions
4.body: In Live sessions you start a class quiz with a join code or QR, with polls, exit tickets and an optional game mode.

5.title: See the results
5.body: Analytics shows each objective, the hardest questions, every student's answers and proctoring events.

6.title: Help is always here
6.body: The question mark at the top opens the help center, this tour, feedback and display settings.

1.title: Welcome to Gradix
1.body: Your exams and results live here, in your language.

2.title: Your exams
2.body: The dashboard lists the exams your teachers enrolled you in. Choose your language and start when you are ready.

3.title: One question at a time
3.body: Each question has its own timer. Answers save as you go, and you cannot go back. You get one attempt.

4.title: Results and practice
4.body: Right after you submit you see your results, a study plan and unlimited practice that does not count.

5.title: Live quizzes
5.body: When your teacher shows a code, open Join live session and type it.

1.title: Welcome, administrator
1.body: You manage the members of your groups: students and instructors.

2.title: Users
2.body: Change roles and help members of your groups from the users page.

3.title: Groups
3.body: Groups bring students and instructors together; instructors can enroll a whole group at once.

1.title: Welcome, super administrator
1.body: You manage every account, group and role.

2.title: AI usage
2.body: The dashboard shows today's AI usage per key against the free limits.

3.title: Plans
3.body: Assign Free, Pro or Institution plans to instructors or whole groups and watch their usage.

4.title: Feedback
4.body: Feedback from users and messages from the contact form arrive at the bottom of the dashboard.

instructor.title: Instructor guide
instructor.s1: Open New assessment and give it a title and, if you like, a short prompt.
instructor.s2: Add source material: upload files, pick from your resource library, or add web and YouTube links.
instructor.s3: Add question blocks: type (multiple choice, true/false, short answer, fill in the blank, matching), count, seconds per question and marks.
instructor.s4: Save. Gradix finds the learning objectives in a few seconds; review, edit, weight or remove them.
instructor.s5: Publish in one or more languages. The question pool is prepared in the background.
instructor.s6: Enroll students one by one or a whole group, and set exam controls: proctoring, exam window, extra time.
instructor.s7: Follow results in Analytics and export them as CSV or Excel. Print papers as PDF or Word.
instructor.s8: For a class quiz, open Live sessions, create a session and show the code or QR on the projector.

student.title: Student guide
student.s1: Sign in and open your dashboard to see your exams.
student.s2: Choose the exam language and read the rules; if the exam is monitored, read what is recorded and accept.
student.s3: Answer one question at a time before its timer ends. Your answers save automatically.
student.s4: After submitting, open your results: per-objective scores, review, study plan and PDF report.
student.s5: Use Practice as often as you like; it never changes your score.
student.s6: To join a live quiz, open Join live session and type the code your teacher shows.

admin.title: Administrator guide
admin.s1: The Users page lists the members of your groups.
admin.s2: Change a member's role between student and instructor when needed.
admin.s3: The Super Admin creates groups, sets plans and reads feedback.
